mapper.select: SELECT ap.id, ap.pattern_name, ap.is_deleted, api.id AS item_id, api.answer_pattern_id, api.item_text, api.item_order FROM answer_patterns ap LEFT JOIN answer_pattern_items api ON ap.id = api.answer_pattern_id WHERE ap.is_snapshot = FALSE ORDER BY ap.id, api.item_order

SELECT ap.id, ap.pattern_name, ap.is_deleted, api.id AS item_id, api.answer_pattern_id, api.item_text, api.item_order FROM answer_patterns ap LEFT JOIN answer_pattern_items api ON ap.id = api.answer_pattern_id WHERE ap.id = #{id} ORDER BY api.item_order
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM questions WHERE answer_pattern_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO answer_patterns (pattern_name, is_snapshot) SELECT pattern_name || ' (Snapshot ' || TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') || ')', TRUE FROM answer_patterns WHERE id = #{id}
INSERT INTO answer_pattern_items (answer_pattern_id, item_text, item_order) SELECT #{newId}, item_text, item_order FROM answer_pattern_items WHERE answer_pattern_id = #{originalId}
